content:
**Lane cards show the joined PR and its latest verdict (#1312)**

New pure lib/card-review-model.mjs builds one index per render from prs, reviews and remoteChanges; the verdict/rev/head come ONLY from buildReviewTimeline (review-timeline.mjs; shapeRound gained the full headSha). Footer: 'PR #n · rev r · VERDICT · head abc1234' plus 'origin tip here <sha>' when the clone's origin tip differs (never the word stale; tooltip says as of the last fetch), '+k open PR(s)' with the highest-numbered PR named; nothing while prs is pending/idle/failed; 'verdict not read yet' when prs read but reviews not. The card's remote line drops 'PR #n' when the footer names it. Footer wraps (ellipsis clipped the origin tip). Gotcha: 'Awaiting review' chip means the issue lacks status:approved, not a PR awaiting review.
